arxiv-2109-04031.title: Binary fractions of G and K dwarf stars based on the Gaia EDR3 and LAMOST DR5: impacts of the chemical abundances Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2109-04031.creator: Zexi Niu, Haibo Yuan, Song Wang, Jifeng Liu
arxiv-2109-04031.description: Abstract Basing on the large volume Gaia Early Data Release 3 and LAMOST Data Release 5 data, we estimate the bias-corrected binary fractions of the field late G and early K dwarfs. A stellar locus outlier method is used in this work, which works well for binaries of various periods and inclination angles with single epoch data.

arxiv-2201-02373.title: Mirror Learning: A Unifying Framework of Policy Optimisation
arxiv-2201-02373.creator: Jakub Grudzien Kuba, Christian Schroeder de Witt, Jakob Foerster
arxiv-2201-02373.description: Abstract Modern deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are motivated by either the generalised policy iteration (GPI) or trust-region learning (TRL) frameworks. However, algorithms that strictly respect these theoretical frameworks have proven unscalable. Surprisingly, the only known scalable algorithms violate the GPI/TRL assumptions, e.g. due to required regularisation or other heuristics.

arxiv-2208-10937.title: Improving Computed Tomography (CT) Reconstruction via 3D Shape Induction
arxiv-2208-10937.creator: Elena Sizikova, Xu Cao, Ashia Lewis, Kenny Moise, Megan Coffee
arxiv-2208-10937.description: Abstract Chest computed tomography (CT) imaging adds valuable insight in the diagnosis and management of pulmonary infectious diseases, like tuberculosis (TB). However, due to the cost and resource limitations, only X-ray images may be available for initial diagnosis or follow up comparison imaging during treatment. Due to their projective nature, X-rays images may be more difficult to interpret by clinicians.

arxiv-2209-13339.title: Clubs and their applications
arxiv-2209-13339.creator: Vito Napolitano, Olga Polverino, Paolo Santonastaso, Ferdinando Zullo
arxiv-2209-13339.description: Abstract . Clubs of rank k k are well-celebrated objects in finite geometries introduced by Fancsali and Sziklai in 2006. After the connection with a special type of arcs known as KM-arcs, they renewed their interest. This paper aims to study clubs of rank n n in PG ⁡ ( 1 , q n ) \mathrm{PG}(1,q^{n}) .

arxiv-2311-10646.title: High Repetition-Rate Pulse Shaping of a Spectrally Broadened Yb Femtosecond Laser Journal: osac Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2311-10646.creator: Julia Codere \authormark 1,a, Michael Belmonte \authormark 1,a, Brian Kaufman \authormark 1,2, Michael Wahl \authormark 1, Eric Jones \authormark 1, Martin G Cohen \authormark 1, Thomas Weinacht \authormark 1, and Ruaridh Forbes \authormark 2,*
arxiv-2311-10646.description: Abstract We demonstrate compression and shaping of few cycle pulses from a high average power Ytterbium laser system. The pulses from a commercial 20 W, 100 kHz Yb laser system are spectrally broadened in two-stages using gas-filled, stretched hollow-core fibers and then compressed and shaped in an acousto-optic modulator-based pulse-shaper.

arxiv-2402-17712.title: A p p -version of convolution quadrature in wave propagation
arxiv-2402-17712.creator: Alexander Rieder
arxiv-2402-17712.description: Abstract We consider a novel way of discretizing wave scattering problems using the general formalism of convolution quadrature, but instead of reducing the timestep size ( h h -method), we achieve accuracy by increasing the order of the method ( p p -method). We base this method on discontinuous Galerkin timestepping and use the Z-transform.

arxiv-2405-01239.title: Fringe trees of Patricia tries, compressed binary search trees, and three other random full binary trees Thanks: Supported by the Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation and the Swedish Research Council
arxiv-2405-01239.creator: Svante Janson
arxiv-2405-01239.description: Abstract . We study the distribution of fringe trees in Patricia tries (extending earlier results by Ischebeck (2025)) and compressed binary search trees; both cases are random binary trees that have been compressed by deleting nodes of outdegree 1 so that they are random full binary trees.

arxiv-2502-18903.title: On Lie isomorphisms of rings
arxiv-2502-18903.creator: Oksana Bezushchak, Iryna Kashuba, Efim Zelmanov
arxiv-2502-18903.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Oksana Bezushchak, Iryna Kashuba, Efim Zelmanov. An associative ring A A gives rise to the Lie ring A ( − ) = ( A , [ a , b ] = a ​ b − b ​ a ) A^{(-)}=(A,[a,b]=ab-ba) . The subject of isomorphisms of Lie rings A ( − ) A^{(-)} and [ A , A ] [A,A] has attracted considerable attention in the literature.

arxiv-2504-16033.title: 𝜼 \bm{\eta} -Einstein Sasakian Lie algebras
arxiv-2504-16033.creator: Adrián Andrada, Simon G. Chiossi, Alberth J. Núñez Sullca
arxiv-2504-16033.description: Abstract . We study η \eta -Einstein Sasakian structures on Lie algebras, that is, Sasakian structures whose associated Ricci tensor satisfies an Einstein-like condition. We divide into the cases in which the Lie algebra’s centre is non-trivial (and necessarily one-dimensional) from those where it is zero.

arxiv-2505-01634.title: Search for new physics in final states with semi-visible jets or anomalous signatures using the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2505-01634.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . A search is presented for hadronic signatures of beyond the Standard Model (BSM) physics, with an emphasis on signatures of a strongly-coupled hidden dark sector accessed via resonant production of a Z ′ Z^{\prime} mediator. The ATLAS experiment dataset collected at the Large Hadron Collider from 2015 to 2018 is used, consisting of proton–proton collisions at s \sqrt{s} = 13 TeV and corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 140 fb -1 .

arxiv-2509-24006.title: SLA : Beyond Sparsity in Diffusion Transformers via Fine-Tunable Sparse–Linear Attention
arxiv-2509-24006.creator: Jintao Zhang, Haoxu Wang, Kai Jiang, Shuo Yang, Kaiwen Zheng, Haocheng Xi, Ziteng
arxiv-2509-24006.description: Abstract In Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models, particularly for video generation, attention latency is a major bottleneck due to the long sequence length and the quadratic complexity. Interestingly, we find that attention weights can be decoupled into two matrices: a small fraction of large weights with high rank and the remaining weights with very low rank.

arxiv-2512-04343.title: The Personalization Paradox: Semantic Loss vs. Reasoning Gains in Agentic AI Q&A
arxiv-2512-04343.creator: Satyajit Movidi, Stephen Russell
arxiv-2512-04343.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Satyajit Movidi, Stephen Russell. Abstract Background: AIVisor is an agentic retrieval augmented large language model (RAG LLM) system for student advising, designed to evaluate the complex trade-offs of personalization in question answering. Objectives: To investigate the nature and direction of performance shift when personalization is introduced to an LLM/RAG system, specifically testing the hypothesis that personalization creates critical metric-dependent trade-offs rather than uniform gains.

arxiv-2603-16565.creator: Han Zhou, Haojie Chang, David Widén

arxiv-2605-28386.title: Order by inertia in spinning active matter: holey fluids and spin-textured crystals.
arxiv-2605-28386.creator: Camille Jorge, Denis Bartolo

pmc-10738653.title: ENGAGING OLDER ADULTS VIA SOCIAL MEDIA DURING A PANDEMIC: SUCCESSFUL LEARNING EXPERIENCES FOR STUDENTS AND ADULTS
pmc-10738653.creator: Krista Cox, Tracey Zeiner, Jennifer Moore, LaVona Traywick, Robin McAtee
pmc-10738653.description: The Arkansas Colleges of Health Education and the Arkansas Geriatric Education Collaborative collaborated on a project to educate senior adults about the use of assistive technologies (AT) for self-care, home management, community engagement, and leisure participation to help them live safely and independently.

pmc-12563129.title: Analysis of Phubbing Among University Students: A Study of Its Prevalence, Incidence Factors and Predictors
pmc-12563129.creator: Pablo-César Muñoz-Carril, Inés M Bargiela, Iris Estévez, Mónica Bonilla-del-Río, Francisco Manuel Morales Rodríguez
pmc-12563129.description: The ubiquitous presence of smartphones has led to new phenomenon such as “phubbing” (the act of ignoring one’s immediate surroundings in favor of using a mobile phone). This behavior has become increasingly common among university students, making it an important subject of study due to its potential negative impact on learning environments.

pmc-12660972.title: Self-passivation reduces the Fermi level pinning in the metal-semiconductor contacts
pmc-12660972.creator: Ziying Xiang, Jun-Wei Luo, Shu-Shen Li
pmc-12660972.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The metal-induced gap states (MIGS) are commonly believed to cause the strong Fermi level pinning (FLP) in the metal-semiconductor contacts. Here, we reveal that the dangling-bond-induced surface states play a crucial role, even comparable with MIGS.

pmc-13144884.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026LB183 TARGETING HRI KINASE TO PROMOTE NEUROPROTECTION FOLLOWING CEREBRAL ISCHEMIA
pmc-13144884.creator: Daniel Romaus-Sanjurjo, Jonathane Furon, Mariña Rodríguez-Arrizabalaga, Manuel Debasa-Mouce, Mónica Castro-Mosquera, Laia Llucia Carol, Alberto Ouro, Israel Fernández-Cadenas, Denis Vivien, Tomás Sobrino
pmc-13144884.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13366248.title: Traumatic hip dislocation in a child with an acetabular fleck sign indicating posterior osteochondral avulsion: a case report
pmc-13366248.creator: Aoi Kudo, Kazuki Oishi, Seiya Ota, Masayuki Ichinohe, Yuji Yamamoto, Yasuyuki Ishibashi
pmc-13366248.description: Pediatric traumatic hip dislocation is rare and may be accompanied by structural injuries requiring surgical treatment. We report the case of traumatic posterior hip dislocation sustained by a 9-year-old boy while playing rugby. Closed reduction was initially performed at a local hospital, but redislocation occurred 3 days later.

pmc-13398722.title: A novel quinazolinone insulin receptor inhibitor and its synergy with an EGFR inhibitor in glucose‐driven glioblastoma
pmc-13398722.creator: Patryk Rurka, Wioleta Cieślik, Wojciech Płaziński, Katarzyna Stępnik, Anna Boguszewska‐Czubara, Elżbieta Kot, Robert Musioł, Mateusz Jasica, Anna Mrozek‐Wilczkiewicz, Katarzyna Malarz
pmc-13398722.description: Aberrant signaling through insulin‐like growth factor 1 receptor (IGF1R) and epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) drives glioblastoma (GBM) progression and therapy resistance. Herein, we describe the synthesis and biological evaluation of W1B, a novel styrylquinazolinone‐based small‐molecule inhibitor. In antiproliferative assays, W1B exhibited potent submicromolar activity against a panel of GBM cell lines.

pmc-13503089.title: ONC201 enhances the radiosensitivity of small-cell lung cancer via inhibition of the FAK signaling pathway
pmc-13503089.creator: Yuheng Yan, Zhaolin Xu, Ziyang Xu, Xun Yuan, Qian Chu
pmc-13503089.description: SummarySmall-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is a highly aggressive neuroendocrine malignancy with a poor prognosis. Radiotherapy is an essential treatment strategy for SCLC but is constrained by rapid relapse and therapeutic resistance. ONC201, an orally bioavailable imipridone compound, has demonstrated clinical efficacy against various malignancies. This study explored the therapeutic potential of ONC201 as a radiosensitizer in SCLC.

pmc-13640162.title: Effectiveness and safety of intravitreal faricimab for macular oedema secondary to retinal vein occlusion: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13640162.creator: Ali Alseneid, Shivam Bhindi, Mohammad Saleki, Diya Baker
pmc-13640162.description: BackgroundFaricimab is a bispecific monoclonal antibody targeting both vascular endothelial growth factor A and angiopoietin-2, approved for macular oedema secondary to retinal vein occlusion in 2023. The phase III BALATON and COMINO trials demonstrated non-inferiority to aflibercept at week 24, and several real-world cohorts have subsequently emerged.
